name: Elsie Mae & More
summary: Elsie Mae & More is a highly-rated boutique shopping destination in downtown Mabank, Texas, offering a personalized retail experience in the heart of this charming lakeside community. With a 4.6-star rating and convenient weekday hours, it serves as a beloved local shopping spot near Cedar Creek Lake.
demographics: The shopping center primarily serves the Mabank community and Cedar Creek Lake area, attracting middle-income families, retirees, and lake visitors. The trade area consists of small-town Texas residents with traditional values who appreciate locally-owned businesses and personalized service. Typical shoppers include women aged 35-65, lake property owners seeking unique gifts and home décor, and tourists exploring the historic downtown district, with shopping patterns favoring weekday visits and a preference for boutique-style merchandise over big-box retail.
description: Elsie Mae & More is a charming boutique shopping destination located in the heart of historic downtown Mabank, Texas at 109 East Market Street. This locally-owned establishment has earned an impressive 4.6-star rating from 29 reviews, reflecting its strong connection to the community and quality shopping experience. The store operates Tuesday through Saturday from 10:30 AM to 5:00 PM, offering a curated selection of merchandise in an intimate, personalized setting. Situated in the picturesque lakeside community of Mabank, known for its proximity to Cedar Creek Lake, the shopping center serves both local residents and visitors exploring the area's small-town charm. With its convenient downtown location and welcoming atmosphere, Elsie Mae & More represents the kind of authentic, community-focused retail experience that defines small-town Texas shopping.
